meta.title: Recruitment profile builder
meta.description: Define the profile you are recruiting for, weight what matters, and rank candidates against it. Every result shows the percentiles that placed it there.

title: Recruitment profile builder
description: Define the profile you are recruiting for, weight what matters, and rank candidates against it. Every result shows the percentiles that placed it there.
intro: Start from a role, adjust the weights, apply filters, then rank candidates.

weights.heading: Profile weights
weights.normalised: Weights are normalised, so they need not add to exactly 100.
weights.unavailableTooltip: This load cannot produce them for anybody, so the ranking would be empty however wide the filters are.

filters.heading: Filters
filters.minimumMinutesTooltipLabel: Does this exclude players by default?
filters.minimumMinutesTooltip: Optional filter. All players are eligible by default regardless of minutes played — this sets a floor only if you want one, and it is empty unless you fill it in.

states.chooseTitle: Choose a role preset or set your own weights
states.chooseDescription: Start from one of the named roles, or set the emphasis yourself. Nothing is weighted yet, so there is nothing to rank by.
states.readyTitle: This profile is ready to rank candidates
states.readyFallback: Adjust the filters, then build the shortlist.
states.errorDescription: The API did not respond, or no weight was set above zero.
states.noMatchDescription: Try widening the filters or lowering the minimum minutes.
states.blockedDescription: This load cannot produce them for anybody, so the ranking would be empty however wide the filters are. Set those weights to zero to rank on the rest of the profile.

results.partialTitle: Part of this profile cannot be scored
results.rankingBody: A ranking of statistical fit against the weights you set. It is not a measure of player quality, and it knows nothing about tactical system, injury record or temperament.

blocked.setToZero: Set that weight to zero to get a ranking from the rest of the profile.
blocked.cannotProduce: {scores} cannot be produced for any player, so this profile matches nobody.
blocked.setOne: Set that weight to zero to run the search.
blocked.setMany: Set those weights to zero to run the search.
blocked.adaptHint: Sets the unavailable weights to zero and shares what they held across the dimensions that are weighted and available, keeping the total the same.
blocked.adapted: Weights adapted. Nothing was submitted — review the boxes and build when you are ready.
blocked.adaptImpossible: Every weighted dimension is unavailable, so there is nowhere to move the weight to. Give weight to a dimension this dataset can produce.

summary.even: You are looking for {subject} with no single emphasis: {items} weighted evenly.
